department: School of Medicine Interdisciplinary Biomedical Graduate Program (IBGP)

deadline.value: The Fall 2027 application is open September 1 to December 1, 2026; files are reviewed as they become complete.
deadline.quote: The Fall 2027 application is open September 1 till December 1, 2026!

also.quote: Please complete and submit the online application, as well as all your supplemental materials by December 1.

app_fee.quote: An application fee of $50 is due before we can begin processing your application.

fee_waiver.value: Fee waivers are available for students who show financial need.
fee_waiver.quote: Fee waivers are available for students who demonstrate financial need.

gre_general.value: The IBGP no longer requires GRE scores.
gre_general.quote: Effective August 2018, the IBGP no longer requires GRE scores.

gre_subject.value: The IBGP no longer requires GRE scores.
gre_subject.quote: Effective August 2018, the IBGP no longer requires GRE scores.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 100 on the old scale, or 5 on the new scale.
toefl_min.quote: A minimum result of 100 iBT TOEFL or the newer scoring, a minimum of 5 iBT TOEFL, a minimum result of 7.0 on the IELTS

ielts_min.quote: a minimum result of 7.0 on the IELTS, or a minimum of 120 on the Duolingo is required for admission to the program

english_waiver.value: The test is waived only for a bachelor's or higher degree from a U.S. or other approved English-instructed institution; India is not named, so confirm with the program.
english_waiver.quote: Applicants who have earned a bachelor's degree or a higher degree from a regionally accredited institution in the United States or other approved English-instructed institution are exempt from submitting English language proficiency test results.

supervisor.value: Students do lab rotations in the first year and then choose a program and lab.
supervisor.quote: The Interdisciplinary first year empowers students to explore rotations in laboratories whose research appeals to them and then to choose a program affiliation.

funding.value: All full-time graduate students receive a stipend, full tuition remission and health insurance.
funding.quote: All full-time graduate students receive a stipend, full tuition remission, and individual health insurance

entry_route.value: A bachelor's in a biological or physical science, mathematics, computer science or engineering with GPA of at least 3.2/4 or equivalent is required.
entry_route.quote: A baccalaureate degree in a biological or physical science or in mathematics, computer science or engineering.

notes: Umbrella first-year program that feeds the School of Medicine biomedical PhD programs (e.g. Cell Biology and Molecular Physiology, Molecular Pharmacology, Cellular and Molecular Pathology, Microbiology and Immunology). 10 to 20 students admitted each year.
name: Interdisciplinary Biomedical Graduate Program
